args.sql:
WITH latest_maintenance AS (
    SELECT 
        upkeeprobot AS robot_id,
        faultpredscore,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY upkeeprobot ORDER BY rects DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        maintenance_and_fault AS m
    INNER JOIN 
        robot_record AS r ON m.upkeepactuation = r.recreg
),
safety_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
        (
            safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops'::float +
            safety_metrics->>'collisions'::float +
            safety_metrics->>'overloads'::float +
            safety_metrics->>'speed_violations'::float +
            safety_metrics->>'zone_violations'::float
        ) AS safety_incident_score
    FROM 
        performance_and_safety
)
SELECT 
    l.robot_id,
    s.safety_incident_score,
    l.faultpredscore
FROM 
    latest_maintenance AS l
JOIN 
    safety_scores AS s ON l.robot_id = s.robot_id
WHERE 
    l.rn = 1 
    AND s.safety_incident_score > (
        SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.8) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY safety_incident_score) 
        FROM safety_scores
    )
    AND l.faultpredscore > (
        SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.8) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY faultpredscore) 
        FROM latest_maintenance
    )
ORDER BY 
    s.safety_incident_score DESC, l.faultpredscore DESC
LIMIT 10;

        faultpredscore,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY upkeeprobot ORDER BY rects DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        maintenance_and_fault AS m
    INNER JOIN 
        robot_record AS r ON m.upkeepactuation = r.recreg
),
safety_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
        COALESCE(
            (
                CASE WHEN safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops' ~ '^\d+$'
                     THEN (safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::float
                     ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE WHEN safety_metrics->>'collisions' ~ '^\d+$'
                     THEN (safety_metrics->>'collisions')::float
                     ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE WHEN safety_metrics->>'overloads' ~ '^\d+$'
                     THEN (safety_metrics->>'overloads')::float
                     ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE WHEN safety_metrics->>'speed_violations' ~ '^\d+$'
                     THEN (safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::float
                     ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE WHEN safety_metrics->>'zone_violations' ~ '^\d+$'
                     THEN (safety_metrics->>'zone_violations')::float
                     ELSE 0
                END
            )
        , 0) AS safety_incident_score
    FROM 
        performance_and_safety
)
SELECT 
    l.robot_id,
    s.safety_incident_score,
    l.faultpredscore
FROM 
    latest_maintenance AS l
JOIN 
    safety_scores AS s ON l.robot_id = s.robot_id
WHERE 
    l.rn = 1 
    AND s.safety_incident_score > (
        SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.8) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY safety_incident_score) 
        FROM safety_scores
    )
    AND l.faultpredscore > (
        SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.8) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY faultpredscore) 
        FROM latest_maintenance
    )
ORDER BY 
    s.safety_incident_score DESC, l.faultpredscore DESC
LIMIT 10;
